notes:
- Pair a light with just your phone, no second light.
- Scenes: save a look and bring it back.
- Control up to 8 more groups at once.
- Own colors for each group, or Group Shows.
- Make patterns and dances, or edit the built-ins.
- Controls in the notification shade. Pick your buttons.
- Keeps going in the background with the screen off.
- Quick Settings tile and home screen widget.
- A quick ✓ when your lights get a change.
- Find My Light now has a signal bar.
- Material You theme to match your wallpaper.
- New heart icon, with an icon picker.
- Modes have names: Beat, Calm and Solid.
- Quick tour for new lights, skippable.
- Swipe left or right to change tabs.
